name: Paradise Beach (Rmilat)
hero_subtitle: A long stretch of golden sand framed by cliffs — Asilah’s most beautiful Atlantic beach, about 30 minutes south of town.

overview.title: Asilah’s Atlantic postcard
overview.p1: Paradise Beach, also called Rmilat, is a wide sandy bay south of Asilah, backed by cliffs and open to the Atlantic. It is less built-up than many resort beaches.
overview.p2: In season you find simple beach cafés and umbrellas; out of season it feels almost empty. Swimming depends on swell and conditions — respect local advice.
overview.p3: Reach it by grand taxi, private transfer or horse carriage from Asilah. Bring water and sun protection.

food.p1: Seasonal beach huts and a full seafood dinner back in Asilah.

food.li2: Drinks and snacks on the sand.
food.li3: Proper seafood dinner on Asilah’s corniche.
food.li4: Bring water and fruit if cafés are closed.
food.li5: Mint tea when you return to town.
